story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless car picks up at the San Antonio airport. A map shows where service began. Two empty cars meet floodwater in disclosed April examples. A recall record counts the cars and quotes the slow-then-drive-in sentence. The remedy is stamped under development, interim weather limits and updates check off by April 20, and the close pairs the open ride with the unfinished remedy.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The film opens on the car at the curb, nobody at the wheel, and closes on the same kind of bay with the door open beside the remedy row marked under development. That answers what the record says without inventing a cause, speed or outcome.
